Components

Browse Atoms, Molecules and Organisms in composition order, then by capability within each level. Go packages follow capabilities. Every component has a direct link in the sidebar. Each entry leads with a native terminal preview, groups alternate snapshots into tabs, and shows highlighted Go usage snippets immediately afterward. Snippets focus on the consumer API rather than a compilable program or the fixture machinery.

Use the Atomic design navigation to jump between levels, and the page outline to reach a component or your browser's Find command to search the entire page. Saved frames preserve terminal geometry and semantic color; use the native runner to inspect colors, focus and animation.

Time-series traces use native braille dots for finer terminal resolution. Shared axes and series colors retain their meaning; ASCII mode keeps its numeric fallback.

Molecules keep related information together within the child's cell allocation. A labeled field wraps help or validation feedback to its native input width; resize through field.Input.Resize(columns). Metric trends keep the current value and unit visible in short allocations. An empty value is unavailable, while empty history does not discard a known current value. Distribution labels and metadata wrap at the supplied width; allow room for their resulting rows.

Legends are opt-in. Set DistributionComparison.ShowLegend, compose BandOptions.Legend or chart.SeriesLegend, or use chart.PanelOptions{ShowLegend: true} with chart.Panel. Allocate its child with options.PlotSize(size, series, palette) so wrapped keys get their actual number of rows. chart.PanelPlotSize remains available for single-row legacy allocations. Legend symbols reuse their plotted styles; label custom boundary markers with BandMarker.Label. Native fixtures accept --legend, and relevant saved variants include With legend. Rendering a panel preserves the native child's state and custom styles; callers own its resize lifecycle.

Text inputs distinguish disabled state with an inactivity shade and a slashed-circle default prompt (ASCII /). Disabling suppresses wrapper focus, editing and the native real cursor; re-enabling retains the underlying native model state. A custom native prompt remains caller-owned. Text.View applies disabled presentation to a copy, while SetTheme reapplies shared styles. Resize reserves the actual prompt width and the native cursor cell. Textarea active lines, line numbers and selection use theme surfaces and colors. Validation messages belong to input.Field.

Saved text, textarea and field fixtures explicitly prepare static focus with cursor blinking disabled. They do not call general scene initialization or execute commands; native interactive runs retain their normal focus and clock lifecycle. Percentage bars keep tiny nonzero values in scientific notation instead of labeling them as zero. When a label cannot fit, a truncation mark signals that limit.

Connection states#

Connection atoms render feedback.Connected and feedback.Disconnected with the shared bright, normal or dim emphasis. Connection state comes from the application; disconnected is inactive rather than a warning, and unknown remains a separate state. Compose either atom into layout.Footer.Status or another region.

Application chrome#

Tabs select an application section. Left/Right wrap around; Home/End select the first/last item. Only a focused tab bar handles these keys; Tab and Shift+Tab remain available to the parent's focus scope. Return the command from Tabs.Update to receive interaction.Selected{Component: "tabs", ID: ...} when keyboard selection changes. Select and SetItems update state without emitting commands. IDs must be unique and stable. SetItems copies the item slice, retains the selected ID where possible and otherwise selects the first item; resize retains selection, focus and theme. The exported Theme can be customized directly and is never rebuilt. Shared focus and selection styles identify the active tab, with reverse video in monochrome; narrow bars show < and > for hidden neighbors and keep the selected tab in view. Very small widths clip the active label.

Header places a title on the left and actions on the right, with a second context row when Context is nonempty. Reserve one row without context or two with context. Actions disappear if they cannot fit beside the full title; the title clips only when it exceeds the allocation. Action strings are display content: the application owns their bindings and effects.

Footer places help on the left and status on the right in one row. Status disappears when both cannot fit, then help clips to the allocation. Both fields accept styled text, including native help output. Header and footer fields use only their first line; none of these components wrap. Widths are terminal cells, including wide Unicode labels and ANSI styling; nonpositive widths render nothing.

See the application shell for these components composed around an active content panel. Sidebar navigation, breadcrumbs and toolbars remain separate future patterns.

Fixture implementation#
Fixture source · Upstream
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"time"

	"github.com/NimbleMarkets/ntcharts/v2/linechart/timeserieslinechart"
	"github.com/lanej/charmed/chart"
	"github.com/lanej/charmed/layout"
	"github.com/lanej/charmed/theme"
)

func main() {
	palette := theme.New(theme.Dark)
	size := layout.Size{Width: 80, Height: 18}
	series := []chart.TimeSeriesData{{ID: "requests", Label: "Requests", Unit: "req/min"}}
	start := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for i := range 32 {
		series[0].Points = append(series[0].Points, timeserieslinechart.TimePoint{
			Time:  start.Add(time.Duration(i) * time.Minute),
			Value: 800 + 120*math.Sin(float64(i)*0.3),
		})
	}
	plot := chart.NewTimeSeries(series, chart.PanelPlotSize(size), palette)
	fmt.Println(chart.Panel("Request throughput", plot, series, size, palette, false))
}

func chartStory(kind string, e Environment) (runtime.Scene, error) {
	t := e.Config.Palette()
	step := 0
	currentSize := e.Config.Size()
	var render func() string
	var update func(tea.Msg) tea.Cmd
	var rebuild func(layout.Size)
	rebuild = func(size layout.Size) {
		currentSize = size
		plotSize := layout.Size{Width: size.Width, Height: max(1, size.Height-6)}
		update = nil
		switch kind {
		case "sparkline":
			values := sampleValues(48, step, e.Config.Amount)
			plot := chart.NewSparkline(values, layout.Size{Width: size.Width, Height: max(1, min(5, plotSize.Height))}, t)
			render = func() string { return plot.View() + fmt.Sprintf("\n\nLatest %.1f req/min", values[len(values)-1]) }
		case "timeseries":
			data := sampleSeries(e.Config.Series, step, e.Config.Amount)
			plot := chart.NewTimeSeries(data, plotSize, t)
			plot.Focus()
			render = func() string {
				view := plot.View()
				if e.Config.Legend {
					view += "\n" + chart.Legend(data, t)
				}
				return view
			}
			update = func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd { var cmd tea.Cmd; plot, cmd = plot.Update(msg); return cmd }
		case "line", "scatter":
			plot := chart.NewLine(plotSize, 0, 31, 0, 120, t)
			plot.Focus()
			draw := func() {
				plot.Clear()
				plot.DrawXYAxisAndLabel()
				for s := range e.Config.Series {
					values := sampleValues(32, step+s*3, e.Config.Amount-float64(s*10))
					style := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(t.SeriesColor(s))
					for i, v := range values {
						p := canvas.Float64Point{X: float64(i), Y: v}
						if kind == "scatter" {
							plot.DrawRuneWithStyle(p, '●', style)
						} else if i > 0 {
							plot.DrawBrailleLineWithStyle(canvas.Float64Point{X: float64(i - 1), Y: values[i-1]}, p, style)
						}
					}
				}
			}
			draw()
			render = plot.View
			update = func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd { var cmd tea.Cmd; plot, cmd = plot.Update(msg); draw(); return cmd }
		case "bars":
			opts := []barchart.Option{}
			if e.Config.Horizontal {
				opts = append(opts, barchart.WithHorizontalBars())
			}
			plot := chart.NewBars(plotSize, t, opts...)
			for i, name := range []string{"API", "Events", "Jobs", "Storage", "Schedule"} {
				values := []barchart.BarValue{}
				for s := range e.Config.Series {
					values = append(values, barchart.BarValue{Name: fmt.Sprintf("Series %d", s+1), Value: 20 + float64((i+s+step)*13%50), Style: lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(t.SeriesColor(s))})
				}
				plot.Push(barchart.BarData{Label: name, Values: values})
			}
			plot.Draw()
			render = plot.View
		case "heatmap":
			plot := chart.NewHeatmap(plotSize, t, heatmap.WithValueRange(0, 100), heatmap.WithCellSize(1, 1))
			plot.SetXYRange(0, 12, 0, 8)
			plot.SetViewXYRange(0, 12, 0, 8)
			for x := range 12 {
				for y := range 8 {
					plot.Push(heatmap.NewHeatPoint(float64(x), float64(y), 50+45*math.Sin(float64(x+y+step)*.4)))
				}
			}
			plot.Draw()
			render = plot.View
		case "stream":
			plot := chart.NewStream(plotSize, t, streamlinechart.WithYRange(0, 120))
			for _, v := range sampleValues(max(32, size.Width), step, e.Config.Amount) {
				plot.Push(v)
			}
			plot.DrawAll()
			render = plot.View
		case "wave":
			plot := chart.NewWave(plotSize, t, wavelinechart.WithXYRange(0, 31, 0, 120))
			for i, v := range sampleValues(32, step, e.Config.Amount) {
				plot.PlotDataSet("observed", canvas.Float64Point{X: float64(i), Y: v})
			}
			plot.DrawAll()
			render = plot.View
		case "ohlc":
			data := sampleSeries(4, step, e.Config.Amount)
			names := []string{"open", "high", "low", "close"}
			for i := range data {
				data[i].ID = names[i]
				data[i].Label = names[i]
				for p := range data[i].Points {
					base := sampleValues(32, step, e.Config.Amount)[p]
					offset := []float64{0, 9, -7, 4}[i]
					data[i].Points[p].Value = base + offset
				}
			}
			plot := chart.NewTimeSeries(data, plotSize, t)
			plot.Bubble.Clear()
			plot.Bubble.DrawCandle("open", "high", "low", "close", t.Text().Foreground(t.Success), t.Text().Foreground(t.Danger))
			render = plot.Bubble.View
		case "canvas":
			plot := chart.NewCanvas(plotSize, t)
			for x := range max(0, size.Width) {
				for y := range max(0, plotSize.Height) {
					if (x+y+step)%7 == 0 {
						plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: x, Y: y}, '·', t.Subtle())
					}
				}
			}
			plot.SetStringWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: 2, Y: 2}, "CHARMED / ntcharts canvas", t.Heading())
			render = plot.View
		}
	}
	tick := func() tea.Cmd { return tea.Tick(time.Second, func(time.Time) tea.Msg { return chartPulse{} }) }
	s := &scene{init: func() tea.Cmd {
		if e.Config.Live && !t.ReducedMotion {
			return tick()
		}
		return nil
	}, resize: rebuild, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd {
		_, manual := msg.(runtime.StepMsg)
		_, pulse := msg.(chartPulse)
		if manual || pulse {
			step++
			rebuild(currentSize)
			emit(e, map[string]any{"type": "chart-step", "step": step})
			if pulse && e.Config.Live && !t.ReducedMotion {
				return tick()
			}
			return nil
		}
		if update != nil {
			return update(msg)
		}
		return nil
	}, view: func(size layout.Size) string {
		if stateMessage(e) != "" {
			return title("Chart / "+kind, e) + stateMessage(e)
		}
		if size.Width < 20 || size.Height < 12 {
			return title(kind, e) + "Increase terminal size to see the chart."
		}
		if t.ASCII {
			return title(kind+" / text fallback", e) + fmt.Sprintf("%d series / latest %.1f\n\nASCII mode presents values without chart glyphs.", e.Config.Series, e.Config.Amount)
		}
		return title("Chart / "+kind, e) + render() + footer("Ctrl+N advances fixture data / arrows pan supported plots", e)
	}}
	rebuild(e.Config.Size())
	return s, nil
}

	var rebuild func(layout.Size)
	rebuild = func(size layout.Size) {
		currentSize = size

		update = nil
		switch kind {
		case "sparkline":
			values := sampleValues(48, step, e.Config.Amount)
			plot := chart.NewSparkline(values, layout.Size{Width: size.Width, Height: max(1, min(5, plotSize.Height))}, t)
			render = func() string { return plot.View() + fmt.Sprintf("\n\nLatest %.1f req/min", values[len(values)-1]) }
		case "timeseries":
			data := sampleSeries(e.Config.Series, step, e.Config.Amount)
			plot := chart.NewTimeSeries(data, plotSize, t)
			plot.Focus()
			render = func() string {
				view := plot.View()
				if e.Config.Legend {
					view += "\n" + chart.Legend(data, t)
				}
				return view
			}
			update = func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd { var cmd tea.Cmd; plot, cmd = plot.Update(msg); return cmd }
		case "line", "scatter":
			plot := chart.NewLine(plotSize, 0, 31, 0, 120, t)
			plot.Focus()
			draw := func() {
				plot.Clear()
				plot.DrawXYAxisAndLabel()
				for s := range e.Config.Series {
					values := sampleValues(32, step+s*3, e.Config.Amount-float64(s*10))
					style := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(t.SeriesColor(s))
					for i, v := range values {
						p := canvas.Float64Point{X: float64(i), Y: v}
						if kind == "scatter" {
							plot.DrawRuneWithStyle(p, '●', style)
						} else if i > 0 {
							plot.DrawBrailleLineWithStyle(canvas.Float64Point{X: float64(i - 1), Y: values[i-1]}, p, style)
						}
					}
				}
			}
			draw()
			render = plot.View
			update = func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd { var cmd tea.Cmd; plot, cmd = plot.Update(msg); draw(); return cmd }
		case "bars":
			opts := []barchart.Option{}
			if e.Config.Horizontal {
				opts = append(opts, barchart.WithHorizontalBars())
			}
			plot := chart.NewBars(plotSize, t, opts...)
			for i, name := range []string{"API", "Events", "Jobs", "Storage", "Schedule"} {
				values := []barchart.BarValue{}
				for s := range e.Config.Series {
					values = append(values, barchart.BarValue{Name: fmt.Sprintf("Series %d", s+1), Value: 20 + float64((i+s+step)*13%50), Style: lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(t.SeriesColor(s))})
				}
				plot.Push(barchart.BarData{Label: name, Values: values})
			}
			plot.Draw()
			render = plot.View
		case "heatmap":
			plot := chart.NewHeatmap(plotSize, t, heatmap.WithValueRange(0, 100), heatmap.WithCellSize(1, 1))
			plot.SetXYRange(0, 12, 0, 8)
			plot.SetViewXYRange(0, 12, 0, 8)
			for x := range 12 {
				for y := range 8 {
					plot.Push(heatmap.NewHeatPoint(float64(x), float64(y), 50+45*math.Sin(float64(x+y+step)*.4)))
				}
			}
			plot.Draw()
			render = plot.View
		case "stream":
			plot := chart.NewStream(plotSize, t, streamlinechart.WithYRange(0, 120))
			for _, v := range sampleValues(max(32, size.Width), step, e.Config.Amount) {
				plot.Push(v)
			}
			plot.DrawAll()
			render = plot.View
		case "wave":
			plot := chart.NewWave(plotSize, t, wavelinechart.WithXYRange(0, 31, 0, 120))
			for i, v := range sampleValues(32, step, e.Config.Amount) {
				plot.PlotDataSet("observed", canvas.Float64Point{X: float64(i), Y: v})
			}
			plot.DrawAll()
			render = plot.View
		case "ohlc":
			data := sampleSeries(4, step, e.Config.Amount)
			names := []string{"open", "high", "low", "close"}
			for i := range data {
				data[i].ID = names[i]
				data[i].Label = names[i]
				for p := range data[i].Points {
					base := sampleValues(32, step, e.Config.Amount)[p]
					offset := []float64{0, 9, -7, 4}[i]
					data[i].Points[p].Value = base + offset
				}
			}
			plot := chart.NewTimeSeries(data, plotSize, t)
			plot.Bubble.Clear()
			plot.Bubble.DrawCandle("open", "high", "low", "close", t.Text().Foreground(t.Success), t.Text().Foreground(t.Danger))
			render = plot.Bubble.View
		case "canvas":
			plot := chart.NewCanvas(plotSize, t)
			for x := range max(0, size.Width) {
				for y := range max(0, plotSize.Height) {
					if (x+y+step)%7 == 0 {
						plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: x, Y: y}, '·', t.Subtle())
					}
				}
			}
			plot.SetStringWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: 2, Y: 2}, "CHARMED / ntcharts canvas", t.Heading())
			render = plot.View
		}
	}
	tick := func() tea.Cmd { return tea.Tick(time.Second, func(time.Time) tea.Msg { return chartPulse{} }) }
	s := &scene{init: func() tea.Cmd {
		if e.Config.Live && !t.ReducedMotion {
			return tick()
		}
		return nil
	}, resize: rebuild, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd {
		_, manual := msg.(runtime.StepMsg)
		_, pulse := msg.(chartPulse)
		if manual || pulse {
			step++
			rebuild(currentSize)
			emit(e, map[string]any{"type": "chart-step", "step": step})
			if pulse && e.Config.Live && !t.ReducedMotion {
				return tick()
			}
			return nil
		}
		if update != nil {
			return update(msg)
		}
		return nil
	}, view: func(size layout.Size) string {
		if stateMessage(e) != "" {
			return title("Chart / "+kind, e) + stateMessage(e)
		}
		if size.Width < 20 || size.Height < 12 {
			return title(kind, e) + "Increase terminal size to see the chart."
		}
		if t.ASCII {
			return title(kind+" / text fallback", e) + fmt.Sprintf("%d series / latest %.1f\n\nASCII mode presents values without chart glyphs.", e.Config.Series, e.Config.Amount)
		}
		return title("Chart / "+kind, e) + render() + footer("Ctrl+N advances fixture data / arrows pan supported plots", e)
	}}
	rebuild(e.Config.Size())

Interval band#

Nested caller-supplied intervals, a mean and selected observation rendered on an ntcharts canvas.

Native preview#
Saved terminal output · truecolor reference
DefaultNarrow256 colors16 colorsMonochromeWith legend
Fixture implementation#
Fixture source · Upstream
// IntervalBand is a one-row ntcharts canvas primitive. Density encodes nested
// intervals independently of color; a selected observation gets a distinct mark.
// Invalid geometry produces an explicit fallback instead of a misleading band.
func IntervalBand(o BandOptions, width int, t theme.Theme) string {
	if width <= 0 {
		return ""
	}
	if !validBand(o) {
		return layout.Fit("Invalid interval", layout.Size{Width: width, Height: 1})
	}

	plot := NewCanvas(layout.Size{Width: width, Height: 1}, t)
	style := bandStyle(o, t)
	for x := range width {
		plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: x}, '·', t.Subtle())
		if t.ASCII {
			plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: x}, '.', t.Subtle())
		}
	}
	project := func(v float64) int {
		return int(math.Round((max(o.Min, min(o.Max, v)) - o.Min) / (o.Max - o.Min) * float64(width-1)))
	}
	intervals := append([]Interval(nil), o.Intervals...)
	sort.SliceStable(intervals, func(i, j int) bool { return intervals[i].High-intervals[i].Low > intervals[j].High-intervals[j].Low })
	glyphs := []rune{'░', '▒', '▓'}
	if t.ASCII {
		glyphs = []rune{'.', '=', '#'}
	}
	for level, i := range intervals {
		if i.High < o.Min || i.Low > o.Max {
			continue
		}
		for x := project(i.Low); x <= project(i.High); x++ {
			plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: x}, glyphs[min(level+max(0, 3-len(intervals)), len(glyphs)-1)], style)
		}
	}
	if o.Center >= o.Min && o.Center <= o.Max {
		plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: project(o.Center)}, '|', style.Bold(true))
	}
	for _, marker := range o.Markers {
		if finite(marker.Value) && marker.Value >= o.Min && marker.Value <= o.Max {
			plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: project(marker.Value)}, marker.Glyph, marker.Style)
		}
	}
	if o.Selected != nil && finite(*o.Selected) && *o.Selected >= o.Min && *o.Selected <= o.Max {
		plot.SetRuneWithStyle(canvas.Point{X: project(*o.Selected)}, 'X', selectedStyle(t))
	}
	return layout.Fit(plot.View(), layout.Size{Width: width, Height: 1})
}

func tableStory(e Environment) (runtime.Scene, error) {
	rows := []table.Row{{"API gateway", "Healthy", "1,240"}, {"Event stream", "Healthy", "860"}, {"Job workers", "Degraded", "420"}, {"Storage", "Healthy", "640"}}
	if e.Config.State == "empty" {
		rows = nil
	}
	m := collection.NewTable([]table.Column{{Title: "Service", Width: 25}, {Title: "State", Width: 15}, {Title: "Req/min", Width: 12}}, rows, e.Config.Columns, e.Config.Rows-5, e.Config.Palette())
	return &scene{resize: func(s layout.Size) { m.SetWidth(s.Width); m.SetHeight(max(1, s.Height-5)) }, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd {
		var cmd tea.Cmd
		m, cmd = m.Update(msg)
		if k, ok := msg.(tea.KeyPressMsg); ok {
			emit(e, map[string]any{"type": "row", "cursor": m.Cursor(), "key": k.String()})
		}
		return cmd
	}, view: func(layout.Size) string {
		if stateMessage(e) != "" {
			return title("Table", e) + stateMessage(e)
		}
		return title("Table", e) + m.View() + footer("Up / down selects a row", e)
	}}, nil
}

func spinnerStory(e Environment) (runtime.Scene, error) {
	m := feedback.NewSpinner(e.Config.Palette())

	return &scene{init: func() tea.Cmd {
		if e.Config.Live && !e.Config.Palette().ReducedMotion {
			return m.Tick
		}

		return nil
	}, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd {
		if _, ok := msg.(runtime.StepMsg); ok {

		m, cmd = m.Update(msg)

		if !e.Config.Live {
			return nil

		return cmd
	}, view: func(layout.Size) string {
		return title("Loading indicator", e) + m.View() + "  Processing fixture data" + footer("Live runs the native clock / Ctrl+N advances a frame", e)
	}}, nil
}

package feedback

import (
	"image/color"

	"github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi"
	"github.com/lanej/charmed/text"
	"github.com/lanej/charmed/theme"
)

// Status is display state, independent of attention-rule evaluation.
type Status string

const (
	OK           Status = "OK"
	Warn         Status = "WARN"
	Error        Status = "ERROR"
	Unknown      Status = "UNKNOWN"
	Off          Status = "OFF"
	Pending      Status = "PENDING"
	Running      Status = "RUNNING"
	Paused       Status = "PAUSED"
	Disabled     Status = "DISABLED"
	Connected    Status = "CONNECTED"
	Disconnected Status = "DISCONNECTED"
)

// Statuses returns the display catalog in its learning order.
func Statuses() []Status {
	return []Status{OK, Warn, Error, Unknown, Off, Pending, Running, Paused, Disabled, Connected, Disconnected}
}

// MaxStatusWidth includes the glyph, separating space and horizontal insets.
// All emphasis levels retain this geometry.
func MaxStatusWidth(t theme.Theme) int {
	width := 0
	for _, status := range Statuses() {
		width = max(width, ansi.StringWidth(status.View(text.Normal, t)))
	}

	return width
}

func (s Status) View(emphasis text.Emphasis, t theme.Theme, options ...text.Presentation) string {
	tone := text.Neutral
	glyph := theme.GlyphUnknown

	switch s {
	case OK:
		tone = text.Success
		glyph = theme.GlyphOK
	case Warn:
		tone = text.Warning
		glyph = theme.GlyphWarning
	case Error:
		tone = text.Danger
		glyph = theme.GlyphError
	case Unknown:
		t = statusTheme(t, t.Unknown, t.DimUnknown)
	case Off:
		glyph = theme.GlyphOff
		t = statusTheme(t, t.Inactive, t.DimInactive)
	case Pending:
		glyph = theme.GlyphPending
		t = statusTheme(t, t.Pending, t.DimPending)
	case Running:
		glyph = theme.GlyphRunning
		t = statusTheme(t, t.Running, t.DimRunning)
	case Paused:
		glyph = theme.GlyphPaused
		t = statusTheme(t, t.Paused, t.DimPaused)
	case Connected:
		tone = text.Success
		glyph = theme.GlyphConnected
	case Disconnected:
		glyph = theme.GlyphDisconnected

		t = statusTheme(t, t.Inactive, t.DimInactive)
	case Disabled:
		glyph = theme.GlyphDisabled
		t = statusTheme(t, t.Inactive, t.DimInactive)
	default:
		s = Unknown
		t = statusTheme(t, t.Unknown, t.DimUnknown)
	}

	mode := text.DefaultPresentation
	if len(options) > 0 {
		mode = options[0]
	}

	return text.Pill(mode.Format(t.Glyph(glyph), string(s)), tone, t, emphasis)
}

func statusTheme(t theme.Theme, normal, dim color.Color) theme.Theme {
	if normal != nil {
		t.Foreground = normal
	}

	if dim != nil {
		t.DimForeground = dim
	}

	return t
}

// Follow distinguishes live-follow mode from paused history browsing.
func Follow(following bool, emphasis text.Emphasis, t theme.Theme, options ...text.Presentation) string {
	if !following {

	}

	if len(options) > 0 {

	}

}

Proportional vertical line scrollbar with bounded offsets, ASCII fallback and a stable empty gutter.

Fixture implementation#
Fixture source · Upstream
func (s Scrollbar) View(t theme.Theme) string {
	if s.Height <= 0 {
		return ""
	}

	rows := make([]string, s.Height)
	for i := range rows {
		rows[i] = " "
	}

	if s.Total <= max(0, s.Visible) || s.Total <= 0 || s.Visible <= 0 {
		return strings.Join(rows, "\n")
	}

	thumb := max(1, min(s.Height, int(math.Round(float64(s.Visible)/float64(s.Total)*float64(s.Height)))))
	offset := min(max(0, s.Offset), s.Total-s.Visible)

	start := int(math.Round(float64(offset) / float64(s.Total-s.Visible) * float64(s.Height-thumb)))
	for i := range rows {
		if i >= start && i < start+thumb {
			rows[i] = t.Heading().Render(t.Glyph(theme.GlyphScrollThumb))
		} else {
			rows[i] = t.Subtle().Render(t.Glyph(theme.GlyphScrollTrack))
		}
	}

	return strings.Join(rows, "\n")
}

// FormatURL changes only display. Escaped paths and query ordering are retained;
// malformed or opaque targets fall back to the captured value without guessing.
func FormatURL(value string, format URLFormat) string {
	switch format {
	case DefaultURLFormat:
		format = PathAndQuery
	case FullURL:
		return Inline(value)
	case PathOnly, PathAndQuery, HostAndPath:
	default:
		return Inline(value)
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
	if err != nil || parsed.Opaque != "" {
		return Inline(value)
	}

	path := parsed.EscapedPath()
	if path == "" && parsed.Host != "" {
		path = "/"
	}

	if format != PathOnly && (parsed.RawQuery != "" || parsed.ForceQuery) {
		path += "?" + parsed.RawQuery
	}

	if format == HostAndPath {
		path = parsed.Host + path
	}

	return Inline(path)
}

func HTTPMethod(method string, t theme.Theme) string {
	foreground := t.HTTP.Other

	switch method {
	case http.MethodGet:
		foreground = t.HTTP.Read
	case http.MethodPost:
		foreground = t.HTTP.Create
	case http.MethodPut, http.MethodPatch:
		foreground = t.HTTP.Change
	case http.MethodDelete:
		foreground = t.HTTP.Delete
	case http.MethodHead, http.MethodOptions:
		foreground = t.HTTP.Meta
	case http.MethodConnect, http.MethodTrace:
		foreground = t.HTTP.Other
	}

	if method == "" {
		method = "?"
	}

	return httpAtom(Inline(method), foreground, t)
}

// HTTPStatusCode preserves invalid observed codes rather than coercing them into a class.
// Zero denotes an unavailable code; request lifecycle is displayed by the owning molecule.
func HTTPStatusCode(code int, t theme.Theme) string {
	foreground, label := t.Unknown, fmt.Sprint(code)
	switch {
	case code == 0:
		label = "?"
	case code >= 100 && code < 200:
		foreground = t.Info
	case code >= 200 && code < 300:
		foreground = t.Success
	case code >= 300 && code < 400:
		foreground = t.Info
	case code >= 400 && code < 500:
		foreground = t.Warning
	case code >= 500 && code < 600:
		foreground = t.Danger
	default:
		label += "?"
	}

	return httpAtom(label, foreground, t)
}

// ShortDuration rounds for compact display, without changing the observation.
// Values under one microsecond retain nanoseconds; negative values retain sign.
func ShortDuration(value time.Duration) string {
	var resolution time.Duration

	switch {
	case value > -time.Microsecond && value < time.Microsecond:
		resolution = time.Nanosecond
	case value > -time.Millisecond && value < time.Millisecond:
		resolution = time.Microsecond
	case value > -time.Second && value < time.Second:
		resolution = time.Millisecond
	case value > -time.Minute && value < time.Minute:
		resolution = 10 * time.Millisecond
	default:
		resolution = time.Second
	}

	return value.Round(resolution).String()
}

package text

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"github.com/lanej/charmed/theme"
)

// SignTones is application policy: positive can mean improvement or regression.
// Unspecified positive/negative tones default to success/danger respectively.
type SignTones struct{ Positive, Negative, Zero Tone }

// SignedNumber keeps exact sign and units when color is unavailable. Zero defaults to
// neutral; missing and non-finite observations are unavailable, never zero.
type SignedNumber struct {
	Value     float64
	Available bool
	Precision int
	Unit      string
	Tones     SignTones
	Emphasis  Emphasis
}

func (n SignedNumber) valid() bool {
	return n.Available && !math.IsNaN(n.Value) && !math.IsInf(n.Value, 0)
}
func (n SignedNumber) Label() string {
	if !n.valid() {
		return "n/a"
	}
	value := n.Value
	if value == 0 {
		value = 0
	} // Canonicalize IEEE negative zero.
	precision := max(0, min(9, n.Precision))
	if value != 0 && math.Abs(value) < .5*math.Pow10(-precision) {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%+.3g%s", value, n.Unit)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%+.*f%s", precision, value, n.Unit)
}
func (n SignedNumber) View(t theme.Theme) string {
	tone := n.Tones.Zero
	if !n.valid() {
		tone = Neutral
	}
	if n.valid() && n.Value > 0 {
		tone = n.Tones.Positive
		if tone == "" {
			tone = Success
		}
	} else if n.valid() && n.Value < 0 {
		tone = n.Tones.Negative
		if tone == "" {
			tone = Danger
		}
	}
	return ToneStyle(tone, n.Emphasis, t).Render(n.Label())
}

// Pill keeps its text label in every profile; color supplements its meaning.
// Semantic fills use contrasting theme surfaces, with brackets in ASCII mode.
func Pill(value string, tone Tone, t theme.Theme, emphasis ...Emphasis) string {
	level := Bright // Preserve existing filled pills for three-argument calls.
	if len(emphasis) > 0 {
		level = emphasis[0]
	}

	if t.ASCII {
		return ToneStyle(tone, level, t).Render("[" + value + "]")
	}

	fill := toneColor(tone, t)

	style := ToneStyle(tone, level, t).Padding(0, theme.InlinePadding)
	switch level {
	case Bright:
		style = style.Foreground(t.Background).Background(fill)
	case Dim:
		style = style.Background(blend(fill, t.Background, dimPillTint))
	default:
		style = style.Background(blend(fill, t.Background, normalPillTint))
	}
	return style.Render(value)
}

Fixture source · Upstream
// Syntax highlights escaped source without changing whitespace or executing content.
func Syntax(source, language string, t theme.Theme) string {
	source = Escape(source)
	if language == "form" {
		return formSyntax(source, t)
	}

	if t.Mode == theme.Mono || language == "text" || language == "" {
		return sourceText(source, t)
	}

	lexer := lexers.Get(language)
	if lexer == nil {
		return sourceText(source, t)
	}

	iterator, err := lexer.Tokenise(nil, source)
	if err != nil {
		return sourceText(source, t)
	}

	builder := chroma.NewStyleBuilder("charmed")

	for _, role := range []struct {
		token chroma.TokenType
		color color.Color
	}{
		{chroma.Text, t.Foreground},
		{chroma.Keyword, t.Syntax.Keyword},
		{chroma.LiteralString, t.Syntax.String},
		{chroma.LiteralNumber, t.Syntax.Number},
		{chroma.Name, t.Syntax.Name},
		{chroma.Comment, t.Syntax.Comment},
	} {
		if role.color != nil {
			r, g, b, _ := role.color.RGBA()
			builder.Add(role.token, fmt.Sprintf("#%02x%02x%02x", r>>8, g>>8, b>>8))
		}
	}

	style, err := builder.Build()
	if err != nil {
		return sourceText(source, t)
	}

	var output bytes.Buffer
	if err := formatters.TTY16m.Format(&output, style, iterator); err != nil {
		return sourceText(source, t)
	}

	if ansi.Strip(output.String()) != source {
		return sourceText(source, t)
	}

	return output.String()
}

Fixture source · Upstream
func fileStory(e Environment) (runtime.Scene, error) {
	root := os.Getenv("CHARMED_FIXTURE_DIR")
	var err error
	if root == "" {
		root, err = os.MkdirTemp("", "charmed-files-")
	} else {
		root = filepath.Join(root, "files")
		err = os.MkdirAll(root, 0700)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cleanup := func() error { return os.RemoveAll(root) }
	if err = os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(root, "components"), 0700); err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"README.md", "theme.go", "components/input.go"} {
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, name), []byte("// Charmed fixture\n"), 0600); err != nil {
			cleanup()
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	m := collection.NewFilePicker(root, e.Config.Palette())
	m.ShowPermissions = false
	m.ShowSize = false
	m, _ = m.Update(m.Init()())
	return &scene{close: cleanup, resize: func(s layout.Size) { m.SetHeight(max(1, s.Height-6)) }, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd {
		if k, ok := msg.(tea.KeyPressMsg); ok && key.Matches(k, m.KeyMap.Back) && m.CurrentDirectory == root {
			return nil
		}
		var cmd tea.Cmd
		m, cmd = m.Update(msg)
		if ok, path := m.DidSelectFile(msg); ok {
			emit(e, map[string]string{"type": "file", "path": strings.TrimPrefix(path, root+string(filepath.Separator))})
		}
		return cmd
	}, view: func(layout.Size) string {
		return title("Fixture files", e) + m.View() + footer("Arrows browse / Enter selects / fixture directory only", e)
	}}, nil
}

Fixture source · Upstream
func logStory(e Environment) (runtime.Scene, error) {
	m := collection.NewLogViewer(e.Config.Columns, e.Config.Rows-4, e.Config.Palette())
	step := 0
	appendLine := func() {
		level := log.InfoLevel
		if step%5 == 4 {
			level = log.WarnLevel
		}
		m.Append(collection.LogEntry{Time: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0, step, 0, time.UTC), Level: level, Message: "Fixture request completed", Fields: []any{"service", "api", "sequence", step}})
		step++
	}
	for range 15 {
		appendLine()
	}
	return &scene{resize: func(s layout.Size) { m.SetWidth(s.Width); m.SetHeight(max(1, s.Height-4)) }, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd {
		if _, ok := msg.(runtime.StepMsg); ok {
			appendLine()
			return nil
		}
		var cmd tea.Cmd
		m.Model, cmd = m.Model.Update(msg)
		return cmd
	}, view: func(layout.Size) string {
		return title("Structured logs", e) + m.View() + footer("Arrows scroll / Ctrl+N appends a deterministic log entry", e)
	}}, nil
}

func formStory(e Environment) (runtime.Scene, error) {
	name := "production"
	region := "west"
	enabled := true
	features := []string{"metrics"}
	note := ""
	f := form.New(e.Config.Palette(), huh.NewGroup(
		huh.NewInput().Title("Environment").Value(&name).Validate(func(s string) error {
			if len(s) < 3 {
				return errors.New("use at least three characters")
			}
			return nil
		}),
		huh.NewSelect[string]().Title("Region").Options(huh.NewOption("US West", "west"), huh.NewOption("US East", "east")).Value(&region),
		huh.NewMultiSelect[string]().Title("Features").Options(huh.NewOption("Metrics", "metrics"), huh.NewOption("Logs", "logs")).Value(&features),
		huh.NewConfirm().Title("Enable environment?").Value(&enabled)), huh.NewGroup(
		huh.NewText().Title("Notes").Value(&note), huh.NewNote().Title("Ready").Description("Your fixture settings are ready to submit.")))
	return &scene{init: f.Init, resize: func(s layout.Size) { f.WithWidth(s.Width).WithHeight(s.Height) }, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd {
		_, cmd := f.Update(msg)
		if f.State == huh.StateCompleted {
			emit(e, map[string]any{"type": "submitted", "name": name, "region": region, "enabled": enabled, "features": features})
		}
		return cmd
	}, view: func(layout.Size) string {
		if f.State == huh.StateCompleted {
			return title("Settings saved", e) + fmt.Sprintf("%s / %s / enabled %v", name, region, enabled)
		}
		return f.View()
	}}, nil
}

func markdownStory(e Environment) (runtime.Scene, error) {
	content := "# Terminal documentation\n\nGlamour renders **Markdown** inside a Bubbles viewport.\n\n- Theme follows the terminal palette\n- Content wraps to its allocated width\n- Navigation belongs to this region\n\n```go\nfield := input.NewText(options)\ncmd := field.Focus()\n```\n\n## Composition\n\nKeep content, focus and layout independent.\n"
	rendered, err := text.Markdown(content, e.Config.Columns, e.Config.Palette())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	m := collection.NewViewport(rendered, e.Config.Columns, e.Config.Rows)
	return &scene{resize: func(s layout.Size) {
		m.SetWidth(s.Width)
		m.SetHeight(s.Height)
		if out, err := text.Markdown(content, s.Width, e.Config.Palette()); err == nil {
			m.SetContent(out)
		}
	}, update: func(msg tea.Msg) tea.Cmd { var cmd tea.Cmd; m, cmd = m.Update(msg); return cmd }, view: func(layout.Size) string { return m.View() }}, nil
}
